payload:
[dev-team SECONDARY-drain] done[]-origin claims are stamped but STRUCTURALLY NEVER DISPATCHED.

DEFECT: scripts/devteam-review-claim-secondary-drain.jq was widened 2026-08-08 (FIX-DONELANE-NO-DONEVERIFIED-PRODUCER-DEP-STARVATION, brief docs/architecture-briefs/2026-08-08-donelane-doneverified-producer.md §2 Component 2) to select candidates from .task_board.review[] UNION .task_board.done[], and it stamps secondary_claimed_at/_by/_dispatch_target in whichever lane the picked row lives in.

The read-back query in docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md § Review-Lane SECONDARY-Drain was NOT widened. It still reads:
  picked=$(jq -c --arg t "$NOW" --arg by "dev-team (review-lane secondary-drain)" '[.task_board.review[] | select(.secondary_claimed_at == $t and .secondary_claimed_by == $by)] | first // empty' ...)

review[] only. So whenever the oldest eligible candidate lives in done[], the script claims it, the flow reads picked=empty, and the dispatch block is skipped entirely. The row is left claim-stamped and never spawned. Silent — no log line, no telegram, indistinguishable from "nothing eligible".

LIVE EVIDENCE (2026-08-23T21:58Z tick, verified at source):
  - review[] had 16 status=REVIEW rows with next_agent != "qa" (8 null, 3 po, 2 dev-mcp-server, 1 developer, 1 architect, 1 agent-father) yet 0 review[] stamps existed.
  - Running the claim script standalone produced 4 stamps across both lanes; the live board carried 3, ALL in done[]:
      FIX-COMMIT-PATH-PEER-INDEX-SWEEP-GUARD-SKILLS   target=po  stamped 2026-08-23T13:39:19Z
      FIX-PO-TRIAGE-SIGNALS-TABLE-MATCHES-ZERO-LIVE-SIGNAL-TYPES  target=po  stamped 2026-08-13T16:23:30Z
      TASK_RUNIDLE-1-AUDIT                            target=pm  stamped 2026-08-23T21:58:22Z (this tick)
  - The 2026-08-13 stamp has sat undispatched for 10 days.

SECONDARY EFFECT (unverified mechanism, worth checking during the fix): the picked row's updated_at appears to be bumped to the stamp time by orch-apply's row stamper. age_epoch sorts on `updated_at // reviewed_at // created_at`, so a stamped-but-undispatched done[] row is rotated to the BACK of the age queue. That would make this leak touch a DIFFERENT row each tick rather than re-picking the same one, which matches the three distinct stamp timestamps above and explains why it never produced a visible stuck-row symptom.

FIX (owner: agent-father — docs/agents/** is its exclusive zone): widen the picked= query to union done[], mirroring the script it reads back from. Suggested:
  '[ (.task_board.review[]?), (.task_board.done[]?) ] | map(select(.secondary_claimed_at == $t and .secondary_claimed_by == $by)) | first // empty'
Also consider whether the selection should exclude already-stamped rows, and whether age_epoch should ignore secondary_claimed_at-driven updated_at bumps.

NOT FIXED THIS TICK: the router hand-dispatched pm for TASK_RUNIDLE-1-AUDIT (outer claim task:TASK_RUNIDLE-1-AUDIT held, ttl 3600) to avoid stranding the claim that had already actuated. The two older done[] stamps were left untouched and still need routing to po.
